speaker: amos
text: The LORD roars from Zion and raises His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the summit of Carmel withers.
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will break down the gates of Damascus; I will cut off the ruler of the Valley of Aven and the one who wields the scepter in Beth-eden. The people of Aram will be exiled to Kir,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Gaza, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they exiled a whole population, delivering them up to Edom.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza, to consume its citadels.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre to consume its citadels.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Edom, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and stifled all compassion; his anger raged continually, and his fury flamed incessantly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of the Ammonites, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will kindle a fire in the walls of Rabbah to consume its citadels amid war cries on the day of battle and a violent wind on the day of tempest.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their king will go into exile— he and his princes together,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Moab, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth. Moab will die in tumult, amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Judah, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth; they push the needy out of their way. A man and his father have relations with the same girl and so profane My holy name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. And in the house of their God, they drink wine obtained through fines.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, though his height was like that of the cedars, and he was as strong as the oaks. Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men. Is this not true, O children of Israel?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet of foot will not escape, and the horseman will not save his life.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For they know not how to do right,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They store up violence and destruction in their citadels.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your citadels.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed or the cushion of a couch.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob, declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On the day I punish Israel for their transgressions, I will visit destruction on the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off, and they will fall to the ground.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses of ivory will also perish, and the great houses will come to an end,
name: The LORD

speaker: women-of-samaria
text: Bring us more to drink.
name: The cows of Bashan

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming when you will be taken away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal! Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings. For that is what you children of Israel love to do,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I beset all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread, yet you did not return to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away. I sent rain on one city but withheld it from another. One field received rain; another without rain withered.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: People staggered from city to city for water to drink, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards; the locust devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you did not return to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you did not return to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, that is what I will do to you, O Israel, and since I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind and reveals His thoughts to man, who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth— the LORD, the God of Hosts, is His name.
name: The LORD

speaker: amos
text: Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: The city that marches out a thousand strong will only see a hundred return, and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Seek Me and live!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal; do not journey to Beersheba, for Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Seek the LORD and live, or He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph; it will devour everything, with no one at Bethel to extinguish it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night, who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth— the LORD is His name—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous. You oppress the righteous by taking bribes; you deprive the poor of justice in the gate.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of ‘Alas! Alas!’ in all the streets. The farmer will be summoned to mourn, and the mourners to wail.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even though you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; for your peace offerings of fattened cattle I will have no regard.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take away from Me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have taken along Sakkuth your king and Kaiwan your star god, the idols you made for yourselves.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels, so I will deliver up the city and everything in it.
name: The LORD

speaker: relative
text: Is anyone else with you?
name: The relative

speaker: survivor
text: None,
name: The one hiding inside

speaker: relative
text: Silence,
name: The relative

speaker: relative
text: for the name of the LORD must not be invoked.
name: The relative

speaker: god
text: The great house will be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do horses gallop on the cliffs? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say, ‘Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah.
name: The LORD

speaker: amos
text: Lord GOD, please forgive! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: It will not happen,
name: The LORD

speaker: amos
text: Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: It will not happen either,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Amos, what do you see?
name: The LORD

speaker: amos
text: A plumb line,
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: Behold,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel; I will no longer spare them:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The high places of Isaac will be deserted, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword.
name: The LORD

speaker: amaziah
text: Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words,
name: Amaziah the priest

speaker: amaziah
text: for this is what Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’
name: Amaziah the priest

speaker: amaziah
text: Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
name: Amaziah the priest

speaker: amaziah
text: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.
name: Amaziah the priest

speaker: amos
text: I was not a prophet,
name: Amos

speaker: amos
text: nor was I the son of a prophet; rather, I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
name: Amos

speaker: amos
text: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
name: Amos

speaker: amos
text: Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD. You say: ‘Do not prophesy against Israel; do not preach against the house of Isaac.’
name: Amos

speaker: amos
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: Amos, what do you see?
name: The LORD

speaker: amos
text: A basket of summer fruit,
name: Amos

speaker: god
text: The end has come for My people Israel; I will no longer spare them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the songs of the temple will turn to wailing. Many will be the corpses, strewn in silence everywhere!
name: The LORD

speaker: merchants
text: When will the New Moon be over, that we may sell grain? When will the Sabbath end, that we may market wheat? Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.
name: The merchants

speaker: merchants
text: Let us buy the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the chaff with the wheat!
name: The merchants

speaker: god
text: I will never forget any of their deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Will not the land quake for this, and all its dwellers mourn? All of it will swell like the Nile; it will surge and then subside like the Nile in Egypt.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And in that day, declares the Lord GOD, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the daytime.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation. I will cause everyone to wear sackcloth and every head to be shaved. I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son, and its outcome like a bitter day.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord GOD, when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east, seeking the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day the lovely young women— the young men as well— will faint from thirst.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say, ‘As surely as your god lives, O Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the way of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Topple them on the heads of all the people, and I will kill the rest with the sword. None of those who flee will get away; none of the fugitives will escape.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though they hide themselves atop Carmel, there I will track them and seize them; and though they hide from Me at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though they are driven by their enemies into captivity, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will fix My eyes upon them for harm and not for good.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Are you not like the Cushites to Me, O children of Israel?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For surely I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve; but not a pebble will reach the ground.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All the sinners among My people will die by the sword— all those who say, ‘Disaster will never draw near or confront us.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear My name,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will restore My people Israel from captivity; they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will firmly plant them in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land that I have given them,
name: The LORD
